name: Divinity
source:
This is it, 

Alongside your companions, you've infiltrated the Null's world.

A strange alien world with all kinds of weird creatures.

Your mission is simple: Defeat ''Destiny''

A fourth-dimensional creature set on destroying the timelines.

The hope of the whole of humanity

The fate of every timeline in existence...

...... rests on your shoulders.

Would you grant humanity another chance to survive?

Or...

Would you seek a brand new Existence?

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/divinity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
就是这个，

你和你的同伴一起渗透到了零的世界。

一个奇异的外星世界，有着各种奇异的生物。

你的任务很简单：击败“命运”

一个四维生物开始摧毁时间线。

全人类的希望

现存每条时间线的命运……

……靠在你的肩膀上。

你愿意再给人类一次生存的机会吗？

或者…

你会寻求一种全新的存在吗？

[来自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/divinity]Itch.io[/url]]
